# state of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:stateOf`](gmeow-stateOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/stateOf>

- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The entity whose location state this is — the moving feature whose presence, pose, and velocity are described by this state. Functional: a state belongs to exactly one entity.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) -> [`gmeow:Entity`](../classes/gmeow-Entity.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the single entity whose location state this is; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid attaching one [`LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md) to several entities (mint one per entity).

### How to use

- Set exactly one [`gmeow:stateOf`](gmeow-stateOf.md) per [`LocationState`](../classes/gmeow-LocationState.md); the inverse view is the entity's collection of states.
